scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic with exact symbolic auxiliary checks; no simulated finite-time result is used to assert an infinite-time theorem. Literature coverage is not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Local critical deterministic pairwise SIS closure on n-regular networks for fixed integer n>=3; no global, finite stochastic epidemic, or heterogeneous-degree conclusion. Initial-condition-dependent additive constants in expansions. Historical priority not independently established.
title: A wrong-sign critical logarithm in quasi-static pairwise SIS reduction
